product_one_liner.value: Orange Logic provides enterprise digital and media asset management/content-orchestration software for organizations managing, governing, and activating content at scale.
product_one_liner.notes: Company description identifies it as a content orchestration platform with DAM and MAM solutions.

pricing_page.notes: Homepage navigation/footer links were inspected; no pricing link appears, and product is demo-led.

named_customers.notes: All four are named among customer stories/customer logos.

employee_band.notes: LinkedIn company profile states company size 201–500 employees.

hq_location.notes: The company privacy notice gives its Irvine, California corporate address.

founded_year.notes: Company's About page states its history dates from 1998.

eng_blog.notes: Available blog resources show marketing/product and industry content rather than two engineer-authored posts on product engineering.

public_docs.notes: Public developer portal includes documentation, API references and technical guidance.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: Careers listing includes Applied AI Product Engineer.

model_provider.notes: Reviewed public AI information; Orange Logic says its AI is model-flexible and permits managed models or customer-connected models but does not name a specific provider/model.

compliance_certs.notes: This page specifically names SOC 2 Type 2 and ISO/IEC 27001 as certifications/assurance standards; other listed items were not included unless one of the requested certification names.

last_funding.notes: Crunchbase indicates a private-equity round but publicly accessible results obfuscate its date and amount; cannot complete the requested round record without guessing.

raised_18mo.notes: The only located round is listed as private equity, but its date is obfuscated, so whether it falls within the 18-month window cannot be determined.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The current careers page lists open positions but none titled SDR, BDR, sales/business development representative, or account executive.

launched_6mo.notes: Orange Logic announced Orange Builder on September 30, 2026, and an Agent Studio model launch on September 8, 2026, both within six months before the run date.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The documented Managing Director appointment occurred June 5, 2025, outside the 12-month window. No in-window C-level/VP appointment or departure was found on the company news/team material reviewed.

crm_stack_signal.notes: Read integrations, careers and developer documentation pages; none names a CRM or sales/marketing system as used by Orange Logic.
